notes.title: Prototype state update.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38835842/bdf71dbef44ab67180e3079f10ec11335ed64a8a.png[/img]

I've been working on and off on this game's prototype for a while. And although I like the feel of it I think it still needs some important stuff figured out. 

For me that means going back to the drawing board with this one. Much of what is solved will remain, which happily is actually most of it. But the rest of the stuff prevents me from being able to move forward and out of the prototype stage with Asterminer.

I'm optimistic this will help me understand better what the game needs to be, and in turn let me make a better game.

I really like Asterminer! It's the older project I have. Its first iterations are from 2012! Yikes, that's already 10 years. So I'm super eager to make progress and get it out the door soon!
